content.text: High Point, NC | highpoint.eduHigh Point University is the Premier Life Skills University situated near Greensboro and Winston Salem, North Carolina. High Point University is a private liberal arts institution with 80% of the student body residing outside North Carolina and stemming from all 50 states and 37 countries. The U.S. News and World Report has ranked HPU as #1 Best Regional College in the South for eleventh consecutive year and #1 Most Innovative. High Point University’s educational model is unique and innovative as it focuses on academic excellence, mentorship, experiential learning, modeling values/character, and development of life skills.Representatives Details Institution TypePrivate Campus SettingSuburbanClosest Airport (Distance)GSO (15 mi)Enrollment (Undergrad / Total)5,000 / 6,000Average Class Size20Student-to-Faculty Ratio17:1Student Population(Out of State / Diverse / Intl)80% / 27% / 6%Athletics DivisionDivision IAthletics LeagueBig South Conference Average ACT / SAT24-27 / 1100-1280Average GPA3.52GPA Consideration (W or UW) Admission: UnweightedScholarships: UnweightedApplications / Admits (Admit Rate)17,470 / 11,175 (63%)Deposits6,924Applications AcceptedCommon AppUniversity-Specific App Application Information Test Optional?
